daily_quests.title: ASX 200 Momentum Ranking with Window Functions
daily_quests.description: Using the ASX 200 historical prices dataset, write a SQL query that calculates a 30-day price momentum for each stock. Use window functions (LAG, ROW_NUMBER) to rank stocks by momentum within each date partition. Include: stock symbol, date, closing price, 30-day price change percentage, and momentum rank (1=highest gain). Filter to only the last 10 trading days and return the top 5 momentum gainers for each day. Bonus: Use a CTE to pre-calculate the 30-day moving average for comparison.

daily_quests.title: NSW Road Crash Data Cleaning & Incident Classification
daily_quests.description: Download the NSW Road Crash Data (CSV format) from data.nsw.gov.au. Write a Python/pandas script that: (1) cleans datetime columns and handles missing values in injury counts and speed zones, (2) creates a new 'severity_category' column (Fatal, Serious Injury, Other Injury, Non-Injury) based on the injury counts, (3) identifies and flags outlier coordinates (crashes recorded outside NSW bounds), (4) exports a cleaned dataset to CSV with a summary report showing record counts per severity category and missing data percentages by column.

daily_quests.title: Australian Wine Production Analysis Pipeline
daily_quests.description: End-to-end task: (1) Use Python/pandas to download and clean the ABARES wine production dataset (or wine production CSV from Wine Australia). Handle missing regions, standardise vintage years, and convert volume/value columns to numeric types. Export cleaned data to a SQLite database. (2) In SQL, create a query that ranks wine-producing regions by total production volume, calculates year-over-year growth percentage using LAG window function, and identifies which regions have consistent growth (>5% growth in last 3 years). Return the top 10 regions with growth trends. (3) Generate a summary report (Python) showing regions with accelerating production and those in decline.
